instruction: Please add a new slide titled 'References' at the end of my baseball presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a new slide at the end of the presentation with title 'References'. Original presentation has 8 slides, so expected count is 9. Evaluator verifies: (1) slide count increased to 9 (50% score), (2) last slide title is 'References' (50% score). Custom getter reads the PowerPoint file and extracts slide count and last slide title.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct slide count (9), 0.5 for correct last slide title ('References')

llm_judge_reasons: Getter uses robust three-tier title extraction: (1) placeholder_format.type check for PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE, (2) fallback to shapes with 'title' in name, (3) fallback to first text shape (getters/impress.py:37-61)
This multi-method approach handles different PowerPoint templates, LibreOffice versions, and manually added text boxes correctly
Metric correctly checks both requirements: slide count (50%) and last slide title (50%) with case-insensitive matching (metrics/impress.py:17-27)
Expected values are correct: original 8 slides + 1 new slide = 9 total, last slide title 'References' matches instruction
Postconfig correctly saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure state freshness
Complete instruction coverage: both 'add slide at end' (verified by count) and 'title is References' (verified by last_slide_title) are checked
Partial credit scoring (50/50 split) is appropriate for the two independent requirements
Edge cases handled: returns empty values on errors, handles missing slides gracefully
